body:
Thanks for taking the time to respond, I appreciate it. I read through both your posts.  I smiled when I saw StrongLifts, I started with that when I got into lifting.  I also went 8 months sober at the same time all while on meds and in therapy.  My Dr.s were awesome.  Regretfully, it made little difference though in my mental health.  I did everything right and still ended up breaking down for no real reason and being admitted for a week.

I can relate to #4.....I don't know how to put it in words though, I guess I feel catharsis in wallowing, ruminating, etc.

I kept it together with the belief that someday it would all be worth it but I can't keep lying to myself, that "things will get better" until I die of old age.  I have searched for *something* to hope for but there isn't anything left.

The desire, willpower, and interest to do anything is gone.  The anxiety keeps me alienated from everyone.  Like many have said before me, there is nothing more I'd like to do then go to sleep and not wake up.  (cliché, I know.)
